title: THE WINDS OF WINTER // CHAPTER 1: THE OPENING GAMBIT
narrative: COMMAND WORDSTAR 4.0 // WINDS.DOC: A blank 1,500-page manuscript beckons. George sits poised before the amber monochrome screen, fingers resting upon the mechanical keyboard. Choose how George opens the novel:

options.text: The Doomed Prologue POV: An expendable Night's Watch ranger freezes beyond the Wall and remembers his village.
The 14-Page Feast Description: A forensic breakdown of roasted capon, trenchers, and grease dribbling down chins.
The Bleak Weather & Endless Cold: The bitter howling wind screams like a dying god as snot freezes on mail.
The Meereenese Knot: Endless olive tariffs, pit-fighter liability, and fourteen Ghiscari dignitaries named Harzoo.
The Heraldry & Lineage Tangent: A minor knight's surcoat triggers a four-generation Blackfyre genealogy lesson.
The Urgent Midnight Raven: A raven crashes through the solar screaming 'CORN!' with terrifying news.
The Resurrected Hero at the Wall: Jon Snow gasps awake as direwolf breath and red sorcery knit his wounds.
The Eldritch Maritime Horror: Euron Greyjoy strapped to the prow in Valyrian steel blowing the dragon horn.
